theme: Kể về dự án đáng nhớ

vocab.example: I took ownership of the migration project from day one.

vocab.example: Launching that feature was my proudest moment at the company.
vocab.example_vi: Ra mắt tính năng đó là khoảnh khắc tự hào nhất của tôi tại công ty.

vocab.example: The biggest challenge was meeting the deadline with a small team.
vocab.example_vi: Thách thức lớn nhất là hoàn thành đúng hạn với đội ngũ nhỏ.

vocab.example: The end result was a much faster and more stable system.
vocab.example_vi: Kết quả cuối cùng là một hệ thống nhanh hơn và ổn định hơn nhiều.

vocab.example: We had to tackle a problem with the database every single week.

listening.title: Phỏng vấn: Kể về dự án đáng nhớ

lines.speaker: An (interviewer)
lines.text: Can you tell me about a project you're really proud of?

lines.speaker: Khang (candidate)
lines.text: Sure. Last year I took ownership of migrating our old system to the cloud.

lines.speaker: An (interviewer)
lines.text: That sounds big. What was your biggest challenge?

lines.speaker: Khang (candidate)
lines.text: The biggest challenge was the tight project deadline — only six weeks.

lines.speaker: Khang (candidate)
lines.text: I took a hands-on role every day and made sure to tackle a problem the moment it appeared.

lines.speaker: Khang (candidate)
lines.text: We managed to deliver on time, and the system became much faster.

lines.speaker: An (interviewer)
lines.text: That must have been your proudest moment.

lines.speaker: Khang (candidate)
lines.text: It really was. Seeing the whole team succeed together felt amazing.

lines.speaker: An (interviewer)
lines.text: What did you learn from that experience?

lines.speaker: Khang (candidate)
lines.text: I learned that taking ownership early really helps a team stay focused.

options: Migrating the old system to the cloud

questions.q: What was the end result of the project?
options: They delivered on time and the system became faster

shadowing: Last year I took ownership of migrating our system to the cloud.
The biggest challenge was finishing everything within a tight six-week deadline.
I took a hands-on role and tackled problems as they appeared.
In the end, we delivered on time and improved system performance.
Seeing the whole team succeed together was truly my proudest moment.
